To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there is a strong correlation between the number of internet users and the number of users of internet banking, (2) there is no significant correlation between the number users of internet banking and the amount of money transferred through this method, and (3) there is no correlation between the amount of money transfer and internet banking acceptance.

the online behavior of Iranian users of the internet is a significant factor in the acceptance of internet services, and the more the internet is used for work or teamwork or for financial activities, the more likely it is that internet banking will be used.

the adoption of internet-based banking in the context of Iran is influenced by the purpose of using the internet, and this influence varies depending on the type of purpose and the type of banking activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the purpose of internet use and the acceptance of internet-based banking.
the effects of online behaviour on internet banking acceptance in Iran.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
online behavior of Iranian internet users has an effect on the adoption of the internet banking.

the use of internet for work or team work, finance activities and banking operations, and seeking commercial information have significant relevance to the adoption of internet bank, but the use of internet with the purpose for fun and entertainment and reading news has no significant effect on internet bank acceptance.
the use of internet for business and work, and finance activities, has a positive and significant effect on the acceptance of the internet banking services in Iran.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this paper provides an empirical investigation of the influence of online behaviour on the adoption of Internet banking in Iran.
the results of this study show that the use of online banking in Iran is not widespread and the majority of internet users do not accept internet banking as an alternative for traditional banking.
